title: EXPERIMENTAL FOOTER HINT ON THE LABEL TOKEN
why: Job 113: check 29.33 caught a raw 16px font-size in the experimental page footer hint. The label token is the same 16px, so nothing moves.

edits.replacement: #root #settingsmodal.expmode::after{ content:'enter change    esc back'; font-size:var(--fs-label); }   /* v34.56 (cw-setrevert2): the label token is the same 16px */
